name: Lake Malawi National Park
description: Lake Malawi National Park sits at the southern tip of Lake Malawi in Malawi, taking in a rocky headland, the shoreline and several small islands. It was set up to protect fish, and its clear, deep waters hold hundreds of species, nearly all found nowhere else. Snorkellers can swim among colourful mbuna cichlids, whose diversity has drawn comparisons with Darwin's Galapagos finches.
